definition: Unified student information from the three university examples
encoding_detail: Master, plan, reference or relationship/index data; this table does not directly produce an event in the current ES. Related objects can still have logs from other tables.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE student (student_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, date_of_birth TEXT NOT NULL, phone_number TEXT NOT NULL, home_address TEXT NOT NULL, registration_eligibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(registration_eligibility IN ('ELIGIBLE','INELIGIBLE')), class TEXT NOT NULL, major TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (student_id))

definition: Course offerings and planned teaching schedules
encoding_detail: Master, plan, reference or relationship/index data; this table does not directly produce an event in the current ES. Related objects can still have logs from other tables.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE course (course_id TEXT NOT NULL, course_name TEXT NOT NULL, credits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(credits > 0), instructor TEXT NOT NULL, class_time TEXT NOT NULL, class_location TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (course_id))

definition: Successful registrations; one retained row per student and course
encoding_detail: Actual milestone columns on the existing business object; NULL means not yet occurred. Authored added event columns: registration_requested_at, registration_approved_at, course_started_at, course_assessment_completed_at, course_grade_finalized_at.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE registration (student_id TEXT NOT NULL, course_id TEXT NOT NULL, registration_time TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status='REGISTERED'), registration_requested_at TEXT, registration_approved_at TEXT, course_started_at TEXT, course_assessment_completed_at TEXT, course_grade_finalized_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (student_id,course_id), FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES student(student_id), FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES course(course_id))
